messages:
Priya: Heads-up team — we need to lock timeline for the joint announcement with GateFlow (gateway), NorthStar SI (system integrator), and the LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. Target window: week of May 12. Who's owning greenroom + embargo?
Sam: I can own the greenroom run. Need final assets + demo signoff by Thu. Link to draft checklist: https://share.redwood/sc/partner-announce-checklist
Lena: Legal here — partners need to confirm logos + MSA countersign by Fri COB for May 12. Also confirm embargo date and who is the external contact for PR.
Alex: Technical QA question — are we running marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) simultaneously? Need SKU mapping + deploy tags for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Jordan: Marketplace ops — AWS slot looks open for May 13, GCP earliest May 15. We need a final SKU table + billing contact. Also any HW partner (NimbleCompute) asset approvals?
Priya: @Sam greenroom owner sounds good. @Lena we plan embargo until 5/12 10am PT. PR contact is GateFlow comms (mecc@gateflow.io) and Redwood comms (press@redwood.ai). NimbleCompute legal gave preliminary OK but needs final logo approval.
Sam: For greenroom run I'll need: 1) demo script, 2) stable demo image, 3) smoke test list (latency/cost checkpoints), 4) partner contact on standby. Can someone paste the demo commands?
Alex: Demo runner snippet (local):
```bash
# start demo env
./deploy-demo --env=staging --model=llama-3-7b --adapter=gateflow-1.2 
# run smoke test
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
Use API key with partner flag to hit paired routing.
Lena: Also confirm data flow diagram for legal review — need to show no PII leaks and that Dedicated customers remain isolated. Ping me the final diagram by Thu EOD.
Jordan: Noted on SKU. I'll draft billing matrix and share by Wed. For AWS marketplace we need an AMI/Helm link and demo artifact.
Priya: Quick product ask — are the LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters in the compatibility matrix? Sam: LangChain adapter v0.7 is verified; LlamaIndex had schema changes in v0.4 that broke vector prefixing. I pushed a fix to gateflow-adapter branch and will run regression tomorrow.
Alex: I'll queue a canary test after Sam's fix. Plan: run 100 short queries across Hosted/Dedicated and compare token latency & errors. I can deliver results by Fri morning.
Sam: Can we include an ops fallback in the announcement plan? e.g., automatic roll-to-compatible-model if latency >300ms for 5m. We have that policy now and should publicize it as reliability feature.
Priya: Good call. Add to talking points: reliability fallback + marketplace availability + SI integration case study.
Lena: Final checklist from legal: logos, MSA signed, embargo acknowledged, data flow diagram, partner acknowledgement of quotes. Everyone loop in partner legal if any wording changes.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled — Announcement window 2025-05-12 10:00 PT set. Greenroom: 2025-05-11 09:00 PT. Reaction: :bell: 
Priya: Summarizing owners — Greenroom: Sam; Legal & Logos: Lena; Marketplace + SKUs: Jordan; Tech canary & smoke tests: Alex & Sam. I'll send calendar invites and a confluence page with tasks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll upload SKU table and AMI links by Wed.
Alex: Will post canary logs to the checklist link after tests.
Sam: Running regressions now, will update branch status by EOD.
Lena: I'll follow up with partner legal to confirm MSA timeline.
Priya: Great — closing thread except for updates. Please post any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
